name: remote-job-monitor
description: Run local and SSH jobs with durable event-driven waits and a token-free live dashboard.

interface.shortDescription: Await long-running local and SSH jobs without model polling.
interface.longDescription: Tracks local and SSH command lifecycles, streams bounded output, waits for completion inside the MCP server, and renders a live MCP Apps dashboard without repeated model turns.
defaultPrompt: Track this long-running command and continue when it finishes.
Open the live dashboard for my remote jobs.
